details.description: Spanish pages + htmx fragments. Member and admin UI. Session cookie + CSRF.
SwiftUI on each iPhone. URLSession REST; hs_sess_ token in Keychain.
Claude Code / Codex. hs_key_ in environment; queries and grocery additions.
Router resolver: home-companion.home.arpa → reserved LAN IP. Same name for every client.
443 entry point; 80 redirects. Internal CA and automatic renewal. Proxy to app:8080; block Actuator.
caddy_data persists CA keys and certificates. Distribute public root only; clients validate chain + DNS SAN.
Deployment boundary: one Maven-built Java 25 process. All internal arrows are in-process calls or port implementations.
SecurityConfig; CredentialFilter; RequestAuthorization. RequestActorResolver.resolve(request): Actor. Fresh Accounts verdict on every request.
Package grouping. Two delivery adapters, same core contracts.
GroceryWebController(queries, commands). stock(actor): View; add(actor, form): redirect / fragment. Auth, accounts, admin, images.
GroceryApiController(queries, commands). stock(actor): DTO; add(actor, request): result. Auth, features, accounts, images.
GroceryTools(queries, commands). 3 list tools + groceries_add_stock. Stateless HTTP; READ_WRITE and owner EDIT for additions.
CredentialService(repository, hasher). resolve(token); PermissionEvaluator.effective(credential,module). Accounts, grants, keys, module catalogue.
GroceryQueries / GroceryCommands(repository, imageStore). addStock(actor, command). ShoppingListCalculator: needed=max(0,target−stock).
Actor(userId,credentialId,permission); TokenHasher; ImageStore port; ImageRef. No dependency on adapters or other core modules.
JpaAccountRepository; JpaGroceryRepository; LocalImageStore. Implements core ports; transactions, parameterized SQL and image re-encoding.
pgdata volume. Accounts, grants, hashed credentials, current groceries and 24 h request deduplication. No public port.
icons volume. Validated PNG / JPEG output; PNG, JPEG and still WebP input. LocalImageStore owns filesystem access.

Solid arrows: runtime requests; responses return on the same connection. Dashed: name resolution or compile-time contract dependency. APP is a deployment boundary; Controllers is a package grouping. IDs are separate from titles. Click each component or arrow for technical details. Primary host: Raspberry Pi 5 / 16 GB; Mac optional. No backups, HA or action history.
